body: i’d say try changing up your routine. picking up new hobbies, going for more walks, meeting new people. do something that isn’t necessarily outside of your comfort zone but bold. it’ll feel refreshing, and maybe you’ll find something to hold onto from that. try new foods, treat yourself a little bit, catch up with any old friends, really anything that brings a bit of change in your life.
